chunks: From him, from his father, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from one of his companions, from Abu Ayyub Al-Khazzaz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I saw Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) and the barber was plucking from his beard, so he said: 'Curve it.'

key_terms.دَوِّرْهَا: curve it (referring to the shape of the beard)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Sadiq (asws) instruct regarding the grooming of the beard?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the specific aesthetic and jurisprudential preference for curving the beard (*tawreer*) rather than trimming it straight, a practice attributed to Imam al-Baqir (as). It underscores the distinction between mere maintenance and the cultivation of a dignified appearance (*jamal*) in line with the Prophet's tradition, serving as a key reference for the recommended status of beard grooming in Shia fiqh.
